name: Sakurajousui Kurumi
source:
Soft-spoken and hesitant, Kurumi believes herself to be an unremarkable and plain girl, and has trouble accepting compliments. Easily intimidated, indecisive, and destructively weak-willed, she even refuses to voice any protests when she is put up for sale, instead keeping her objections to herself out of fear of punishment. However, once having learned that she is no longer in her own world, she feels that she no longer has any place to belong, and asks to be taken to a demon’s home of her own free will.

(Taken from eroderekko)
